issue.title: EQL: Make queries using Point-In-Time rely on index filtering

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Point-In-Time queries cannot be ran on individual indices but on all.
Thus all PIT queries move their index from the request level to a filter
so this condition is fulfilled while keeping the query scoped
accordingly.

Fix #63132
